task: Run the bounded technical SEO audit for one explicit public owned URL and return the seo-audit-report artifact
why: Use current repository evidence when a technical SEO decision depends on live HTTP, indexability, crawl, markup or regression state
trigger_when: Project SEO selects seochecker and GitHub file-write plus Actions run/artifact readback are available
do_not_trigger_when: The decision is keyword, market, backlink or ranking context only, current technical evidence is not needed, or Actions readback is unavailable
